what_it_gives: Browser-based: search, visualise, download satellite imagery
Automatic calculation of spectral indices (NDVI, NDWI, EVI, SAVI)
Change detection comparison between two dates
Supported satellites: Sentinel-2, Landsat 7/8/9, MODIS, CBERS-4
Free tier: limited downloads per month

paid_product.name: EOS RayVision
use_cases: Site activity tracking with ML alerts
Security monitoring — similar to what Damocles builds in-house
paid_product.why_damocles_avoids: RayVision is a paid black-box SaaS. Damocles builds equivalent capability in-house (CFAR + foundation models) on sovereign infra — this is the moat vs commercial vendors.

NDWI.use: water body detection, Evros river level

damocles_integration.recommendation: Use free LandViewer browser for demo screenshot generation. For pipeline: use Sentinel Hub CDSE (already integrated) which provides the same imagery programmatically.
demo_workflow: 4. Export PNG → use as evidence in Damocles brief modal
